title: A Undertow for the Blue Hour
author: Ansel Dravenmoor
blurb: Dominic Underhill, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a childhood home goes up for auction, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it before the last bus to the old neighborhood is rerouted forever.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
